dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「――ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Hm, are you awake?"
dialogues.text: "Hm, are you awake?"

dialogues.jp:
小さい、もみじのような形のぬくもりが、胸の
上にのっている。
dialogues.en:
When I open my eyes, I feel dizzy as if my head were
shaking.
dialogues.text:
When I open my eyes, I feel dizzy as if my head were
shaking.

dialogues.en: "Huhh..."
dialogues.text: "Huhh..."

dialogues.jp: 本当にバカだ。
dialogues.en: I breathe out.
dialogues.text: I breathe out.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ、起きた？」
dialogues.en:
"Don't move yet. After you come back from the dream, you may
not be able to move for a while. It's like Nemu-chan."
dialogues.text:
"Don't move yet. After you come back from the dream, you may
not be able to move for a while. It's like Nemu-chan."

dialogues.jp:
目を開こうとした瞬間、｛ずがいこつ／頭蓋骨｝を直接シェイク
されたような、ぐにゃり、とした｛めまい／眩暈｝を覚えた。
dialogues.en: She pats my chest through the cover, like a mother would.
dialogues.text: She pats my chest through the cover, like a mother would.

dialogues.jp: 大きく息を吐く。
dialogues.en: I'm not sure the sound's coming out right.
dialogues.text: I'm not sure the sound's coming out right.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「無理に動かないほうがいいよ。あんなに深く
　夢を見たら、しばらく｛こっち／現｝で動けないよ。音夢
　ちゃんと同じだね」
dialogues.en: "Nyahahaha... I'm here to say goodbye."
dialogues.text: "Nyahahaha... I'm here to say goodbye."

dialogues.jp:
とんとん、とオカアサンのように布団の上から
胸を叩かれる。

dialogues.en: It was sudden, but I'm not really surprised.
dialogues.text: It was sudden, but I'm not really surprised.

dialogues.jp: 声が本当に出たのかどうか。
dialogues.en:
I wonder why? Probably, I already expected that... or I've
experienced that before.
dialogues.text:
I wonder why? Probably, I already expected that... or I've
experienced that before.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃははは……お別れを言いに来たんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"The dream may be pleasant, but I have to bring it to an
end, or else Nemu will be gone soon."
dialogues.text:
"The dream may be pleasant, but I have to bring it to an
end, or else Nemu will be gone soon."

dialogues.jp: 突然なのに、あまり驚きはない。
dialogues.en: Sakura murmurs slowly.
dialogues.text: Sakura murmurs slowly.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「このままじゃ音夢ちゃんが消えちゃうからね。
　楽しくても、夢は終わらせないと……」
dialogues.en:
"If Nemu-chan disappeared, you would feel sad, because she
is your sister."
dialogues.text:
"If Nemu-chan disappeared, you would feel sad, because she
is your sister."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「音夢ちゃんが消えたら、お兄ちゃん悲しいも
　んね。音夢ちゃんはお兄ちゃんの妹だもんね」
dialogues.en:
"I caused you a lot of trouble, then left for six years, but
Nemu-chan's been by your side all this time."
dialogues.text:
"I caused you a lot of trouble, then left for six years, but
Nemu-chan's been by your side all this time."

dialogues.jp:
俺に語りかけているというよりも、自分に言い
聞かせるように。
dialogues.en: She's speaking to herself more than to me.
dialogues.text: She's speaking to herself more than to me.

dialogues.jp: それはまるで――。
dialogues.en: It's like...
dialogues.text: It's like...

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん…………嫉妬……だよね……」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I guess I'm jealous of her."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I guess I'm jealous of her."

dialogues.jp: ｛ざんげ／懺悔｝のようだった。
dialogues.en: It sounded like a confession.
dialogues.text: It sounded like a confession.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「にゃはは。多分、音夢ちゃんが病気になって
　いるのは、ボクが心のどこかで音夢ちゃんを
　邪魔だと思っているからなんだよ……」
dialogues.en:
"Nyahaha. I know why Nemu-chan's been sick... because I
always feel like she's getting in my way, that's why."
dialogues.text:
"Nyahaha. I know why Nemu-chan's been sick... because I
always feel like she's getting in my way, that's why."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そうじゃなかったら……ボクはなんでも出来
　るはずだもん。音夢ちゃんの病気なんて、す
　ぐに治せなきゃいけないのに……」
dialogues.en:
"Otherwise, I would've done many things I wanted. And I
could've fixed Nemu-chan's health instantly."
dialogues.text:
"Otherwise, I would've done many things I wanted. And I
could've fixed Nemu-chan's health instantly."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんて……嫌な子……」
dialogues.en: "How awful I am."
dialogues.text: "How awful I am."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「だから消えるの……」
dialogues.en: "That's why I want to disappear."
dialogues.text: "That's why I want to disappear."

dialogues.jp: 首を振る気配。
dialogues.en: I feel her shaking her head.
dialogues.text: I feel her shaking her head.

dialogues.jp: 小さな小さな気配。
dialogues.en: It feels like she's barely there.
dialogues.text: It feels like she's barely there.

dialogues.jp:
この世の中、こんなにも愛しくて、抱きしめた
くて、守らなきゃいけないモノが他にはないっ
て存在。
dialogues.en:
With Sakura, all you can do is love her, want to hold her,
and protect her.
dialogues.text:
With Sakura, all you can do is love her, want to hold her,
and protect her.

dialogues.jp:
なのに、この身体は指１本どころか、｛まぶた／瞼｝すら開
いてくれない。
dialogues.en:
Nonetheless, this body can't move even one finger, or even
open my eyes.
dialogues.text:
Nonetheless, this body can't move even one finger, or even
open my eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「本当は、みんなに忘れてもらってひっそりと
　消えたかったんだけど……お兄ちゃんだけは
　忘れてくれなかったから」
dialogues.en:
"Actually, I wanted to go away quietly as it was... but I
came here since you didn't want to forget about me."
dialogues.text:
"Actually, I wanted to go away quietly as it was... but I
came here since you didn't want to forget about me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うんん……」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「にゃはは。それは多分……間違いなく、ボク
　が忘れてほしくなかったんだろうね」
dialogues.en:
"Nyahaha. It's because I didn't want you to forget about
me."
dialogues.text:
"Nyahaha. It's because I didn't want you to forget about
me."

dialogues.jp: しばらくの沈黙。
dialogues.en: A long silence.
dialogues.text: A long silence.

dialogues.jp: お互いの息遣いだけが耳につく。
dialogues.en: I only hear our breathing.
dialogues.text: I only hear our breathing.

dialogues.jp: その時間が数秒だったのか、数時間だったのか。
dialogues.en:
I don't know how long it lasts, a few seconds or a few
hours...
dialogues.text:
I don't know how long it lasts, a few seconds or a few
hours...

dialogues.jp: ふと、唇が重なる。
dialogues.en: I put my lips over hers slowly.
dialogues.text: I put my lips over hers slowly.

dialogues.jp: 甘い口付けの最中、頬に水がこぼれてきた。
dialogues.en: As I kiss her, I feel wetness on my cheek.
dialogues.text: As I kiss her, I feel wetness on my cheek.

dialogues.jp:
泣いているんだ。ずっと、笑った声だけ俺に聞
かせて。だから瞼が開かない。
dialogues.en:
She must be crying. She'd been speaking with a smile in her
voice. That's why I can't open my eyes.
dialogues.text:
She must be crying. She'd been speaking with a smile in her
voice. That's why I can't open my eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ごめんね……ボクが消えれば全て元に戻るか
　ら。なにもかも」
dialogues.en:
"I'm sorry... but when I leave, everything will be all
right."
dialogues.text:
"I'm sorry... but when I leave, everything will be all
right."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「もぅ耐えられないんだよ……誰も傷つけない
　ように笑っているのは」
dialogues.en:
"I can't go on like this, always smiling so as not to hurt
anyone."
dialogues.text:
"I can't go on like this, always smiling so as not to hurt
anyone."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「さよなら」
dialogues.en: "Goodbye."
dialogues.text: "Goodbye."

dialogues.jp: そこで――。
dialogues.en: Then......
dialogues.text: Then......

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ボク、たった３ヶ月だったけど、お兄ちゃん
　達との生活は楽しかったよ♪」
dialogues.en:
"We only had 3 months to spend time together, but I had a
great time with you."
dialogues.text:
"We only had 3 months to spend time together, but I had a
great time with you."

dialogues.jp:
最後までそんな言葉を残しやがって、気配が消
えた。
dialogues.en: And she's gone, her last words ringing in the empty air.
dialogues.text: And she's gone, her last words ringing in the empty air.

dialogues.jp:
ゆっくりと上半身を起こす。頭痛もなく、むし
ろ充分過ぎる睡眠で調子がいい。
dialogues.en:
I sit up slowly. I have no headache, and I feel better after
a good sleep.
dialogues.text:
I sit up slowly. I have no headache, and I feel better after
a good sleep.

dialogues.jp: 「かったりぃな……あのバカが」
dialogues.en: "She's such a pain in the neck."
dialogues.text: "She's such a pain in the neck."

dialogues.jp: 呟いて、ふと、頬から赤いものがこぼれた。
dialogues.en: As I say that, something red drops down on my cheeks.
dialogues.text: As I say that, something red drops down on my cheeks.

dialogues.jp: それは涙ではなく、桜の花びらだった。
dialogues.en: It's not a tear, but a cherry petal.
dialogues.text: It's not a tear, but a cherry petal.

dialogues.jp: ◆お別れの言葉◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sakura◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sakura◆

dialogues.jp:
意識が戻ったが、体も頭も痛くて、まともに目
を開くことも、喋ることもできない……。

さくらが傍らで、ポツポツと言葉を紡いでいる。
まるで｛ざんげ／懺悔｝のように、音夢について語っている。
dialogues.en: "Oniichan."
dialogues.text: "Oniichan."

dialogues.jp:
さくらの望むように、なって欲しいようになる
この島で、音夢の体調が良くならないのは、さ
くらが心の奥でそれを願っているから……。
dialogues.en: I feel the warmth in the shape of a maple leaf on my chest.
dialogues.text: I feel the warmth in the shape of a maple leaf on my chest.

dialogues.jp:
さくらは、深い自責の念に捉われ、もうそういっ
た状況に耐えられないのだという。だから、消
えるのだという。
――さよなら
dialogues.en: I'm such an idiot.
dialogues.text: I'm such an idiot.

dialogues.jp: そう言い残して、さくらの気配が消えた。
dialogues.en: I can't believe how happy I am to see Sakura.
dialogues.text: I can't believe how happy I am to see Sakura.
